c74object.name: evi.tone.macro~
c74object.digest: A 'one knob' macroisation for nonlinear cut tone control useful for quick colourisation in your audio chain
c74object.description:
evi.tone.macro~ is a 'max define' for the evi_tone_macro.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.tone.macro~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does.
Similar to evi.damp.macro~ but nonlinear so capable of driving audio input hard into the filter. The 'one knob' macroisation takes this into account. The effect is a dark saturated tone control for colourisation. Forms the output stage of evi.valve~.

inlet.description: Audio input to be tone controlled.

attribute.name: smooth
attribute.description: Smooth the internal coefficients controlled by the 'tone' attribute, set in ms. If 0 smoothing is CPU-off.

attribute.name: tone
attribute.description: The one attribute that does everything. At 0 the input signal is very slightly damped with very little nonlinear effect. At 1 the input signal is 100% dark and saturated. 0..1 the saturation gets stronger and the cutoff frequencies move from extremes to the mid range and the shelves attenuate eventually to full low/highpass filters.
